method: Manually read all six rendered source pages at 2x (p705 also reviewed at 1.7x), then reconciled each instructional line/element to an ordered question. Numbered photos are covered through their printed labels/captions; no hidden or unlabelled image diagnosis is invented. Page headers, publisher/footer, lecture timestamps and blank Active space are non-instructional and excluded.
caveats: p706: no role in humans and kidney of amphibians/reptiles are source-specific overgeneralisations, explicitly qualified.
p707: proteinuria parenthesis prints Albuminemia; distinguish it from albuminuria.
p708–709: older disability/sex-development terms are recorded with preferred terminology.

p709: normal external genitalia in Frasier is not universal; WT2 is a historical source label; microcephaly in BWS is questionable; intellectual disability in Russell Silver is not a universal diagnostic requirement.

p710: sex ratio and incidence are source-specific; RET/PAX-2 associations are not universal causes; Potter is not a universal leading neonatal cause of death; pulmonary hyperplasia caption is an apparent error for hypoplasia; full GDNF expansion is provided.

Headings are context, not displaced facts.
